name: tenstorrent-open-me
description: Machine-checked SPARK Ada proofs about tt-npe, Tenstorrent's network-on-chip performance estimator, produced by a specification-to-proof pipeline with an LLM in the loop and a human reviewing every claim. Reading the code surfaced a real defect: a missing break makes every Blackhole workload with fabric_send events fail ingest. The report keeps the refuted hypotheses and the authors' own mistakes alongside the hypothesis that held. Nothing was run on silicon.
author: the-dark-factory
